# MCSManager Special Edition v4.8.3

---

## 中文

### 更新概要

本次更新修复了分片上传的鉴权冲突问题，优化了文件上传下载处理，并修复了下载链接中文件名编码问题，提升了上传稳定性和兼容性。

### 问题修复

- **修复: 同步上游文件上传下载处理并修复分片鉴权冲突** [ea6b63c](https://github.com/HRxuan/MCSManager-Personal-Edition/commit/ea6b63cc95928f11aab54c8ed6cab984e67ce2de)
  - 解决分片上传全部返回 403 的问题，原因是 token 查询参数被重复写入。包括回归上传校验中间件逻辑，移除部分凭证校验，去除分片地址的 token 参数，修复下载链接中文件名的 URL 编码，避免参数校验误判，并保留私有增强功能如文件体积上限和目录权限校验。
  - 涉及文件: `daemon/src/middlewares/precheck.ts`, `daemon/src/routers/http_router.ts`, `frontend/src/hooks/useFileManager.ts`, `frontend/src/services/uploadService.ts`, `panel/src/app/routers/filemananger_router.ts`

### 提交清单

- [ea6b63c](https://github.com/HRxuan/MCSManager-Personal-Edition/commit/ea6b63cc95928f11aab54c8ed6cab984e67ce2de) 修复: 同步上游文件上传下载处理并修复分片鉴权冲突

---

## English

### Summary

This update fixes the authentication conflict in chunked uploads, improves file upload and download handling, and fixes file name encoding issues in download links, enhancing upload stability and compatibility.

### Fixes

- **Fix: Sync upstream file upload/download handling and fix chunked upload authentication conflict** [ea6b63c](https://github.com/HRxuan/MCSManager-Personal-Edition/commit/ea6b63cc95928f11aab54c8ed6cab984e67ce2de)
  - Resolved the issue where all chunked uploads returned 403 due to duplicate token query parameters\. This includes reverting upload validation middleware logic, removing certain token validations, removing token parameters from chunked URLs, fixing URL encoding for file names in download links, avoiding parameter validation misjudgment, and retaining private enhancements such as file size limits and directory permission checks\.
  - Files: `daemon/src/middlewares/precheck.ts`, `daemon/src/routers/http_router.ts`, `frontend/src/hooks/useFileManager.ts`, `frontend/src/services/uploadService.ts`, `panel/src/app/routers/filemananger_router.ts`

### Commit Index

- [ea6b63c](https://github.com/HRxuan/MCSManager-Personal-Edition/commit/ea6b63cc95928f11aab54c8ed6cab984e67ce2de) 修复: 同步上游文件上传下载处理并修复分片鉴权冲突

# MCSManager Special Edition v4.8.2

---

## 中文

### 更新概要

修复构建产物中的无效本地依赖链接，避免资源管理器删除时出错

### 问题修复

- **构建: 清理产物中指向不存在目标的 common 链接** [51dd661](https://github.com/HRxuan/MCSManager-Personal-Edition/commit/51dd6619c012ccd8165fb66aed4c679dd09204cc)
  - 产物 package\.json 保留了 "mcsmanager\-common": "file:\.\./common" 依赖，但 production\-code 下无 common 目录，导致 npm install 创建悬空链接（Windows 为 junction），资源管理器删除产物时出现“找不到该项目”错误。由于 webpack 已内联 common 包，此声明多余。新增剥离本地依赖声明的脚本，在构建流程中调用，确保 npm install 前移除本地依赖，npm install 后补充删除以兼容旧产物，同时脚本支持不同斜杠格式的锁文件键名。
  - 涉及文件: `build.bat`, `build.sh`, `scripts/strip-local-deps.js`

### 提交清单

- [51dd661](https://github.com/HRxuan/MCSManager-Personal-Edition/commit/51dd6619c012ccd8165fb66aed4c679dd09204cc) 构建: 清理产物中指向不存在目标的 common 链接

---

## English

### Summary

Fixed invalid local dependency links in build artifacts to prevent errors when deleting with File Explorer

### Fixes

- **build: clean up common links pointing to non\-existent targets in artifacts** [51dd661](https://github.com/HRxuan/MCSManager-Personal-Edition/commit/51dd6619c012ccd8165fb66aed4c679dd09204cc)
  - The artifact's package\.json retained the "mcsmanager\-common": "file:\.\./common" dependency, but the common directory is missing under production\-code, causing npm install to create dangling links \(junctions on Windows\), resulting in "project not found" errors when deleting the artifact with File Explorer\. Since webpack inlines common into app\.js, this declaration is redundant\. A script was added to strip local dependency declarations, invoked during build before npm install to remove local dependencies, with an additional deletion after npm install to support legacy artifacts\. The script also supports lock file keys with both forward and backward slashes\.
  - Files: `build.bat`, `build.sh`, `scripts/strip-local-deps.js`

- [51dd661](https://github.com/HRxuan/MCSManager-Personal-Edition/commit/51dd6619c012ccd8165fb66aed4c679dd09204cc) 构建: 清理产物中指向不存在目标的 common 链接

# MCSManager Special Edition v4.8.1

---

## 中文

### 更新概要

同步上游版本10.17.0，修复鉴权安全问题，并将公共模块正确打包进Daemon产物

### 问题修复

- **发布: 同步上游 10\.17\.0 并修复鉴权安全问题** [d0ca5f5](https://github.com/HRxuan/MCSManager-Personal-Edition/commit/d0ca5f51eebbe6f8ee418bda2954b93c7fda5e94)
  - 同步了上游版本10\.17\.0，修复了鉴权相关的安全漏洞，提升系统安全性和稳定性。
  - 涉及文件: `.cursor/rules/backend-daemon-panel-standards.mdc`, `.cursor/rules/core-project-conventions.mdc`, `.cursor/rules/frontend-vue-component-standards.mdc`, `.github/scripts/generate_release_notes.py`, `.github/workflows/auto-build.yml`, `common/global.d.ts`, `common/package-lock.json`, `common/package.json`, `common/src/docker_utils.ts`, `common/src/index.ts`, `common/src/process_tools.ts`, `common/src/system_storage.ts`，另有 239 个文件
- **修复: 将公共模块打包进 Daemon 产物** [3a65e9b](https://github.com/HRxuan/MCSManager-Personal-Edition/commit/3a65e9b502e123ad36ab74afe8733260730b7394)
  - 解决了公共模块没有被正确打包进Daemon构建产物的问题，确保运行时依赖完整。
  - 涉及文件: `daemon/webpack.config.js`

### 提交清单

- [d0ca5f5](https://github.com/HRxuan/MCSManager-Personal-Edition/commit/d0ca5f51eebbe6f8ee418bda2954b93c7fda5e94) 发布: 同步上游 10\.17\.0 并修复鉴权安全问题
- [3a65e9b](https://github.com/HRxuan/MCSManager-Personal-Edition/commit/3a65e9b502e123ad36ab74afe8733260730b7394) 修复: 将公共模块打包进 Daemon 产物

---

## English

### Summary

Synced upstream version 10.17.0, fixed authentication security issues, and correctly packed common modules into the Daemon artifact

### Fixes

- **Release: Sync upstream 10\.17\.0 and fix authentication security issues** [d0ca5f5](https://github.com/HRxuan/MCSManager-Personal-Edition/commit/d0ca5f51eebbe6f8ee418bda2954b93c7fda5e94)
  - Synchronized with upstream version 10\.17\.0 and fixed security vulnerabilities related to authentication, improving system security and stability\.
  - Files: `.cursor/rules/backend-daemon-panel-standards.mdc`, `.cursor/rules/core-project-conventions.mdc`, `.cursor/rules/frontend-vue-component-standards.mdc`, `.github/scripts/generate_release_notes.py`, `.github/workflows/auto-build.yml`, `common/global.d.ts`, `common/package-lock.json`, `common/package.json`, `common/src/docker_utils.ts`, `common/src/index.ts`, `common/src/process_tools.ts`, `common/src/system_storage.ts` and 239 more
- **Fix: Pack common modules into Daemon artifact** [3a65e9b](https://github.com/HRxuan/MCSManager-Personal-Edition/commit/3a65e9b502e123ad36ab74afe8733260730b7394)
  - Fixed the issue where common modules were not correctly packed into the Daemon build artifacts, ensuring runtime dependencies are complete\.
  - Files: `daemon/webpack.config.js`

### Commit Index

- [d0ca5f5](https://github.com/HRxuan/MCSManager-Personal-Edition/commit/d0ca5f51eebbe6f8ee418bda2954b93c7fda5e94) 发布: 同步上游 10\.17\.0 并修复鉴权安全问题
- [3a65e9b](https://github.com/HRxuan/MCSManager-Personal-Edition/commit/3a65e9b502e123ad36ab74afe8733260730b7394) 修复: 将公共模块打包进 Daemon 产物

---

## 变更范围 / Change Scope

| 模块 / Area | 文件数 / Files |
| --- | ---: |
| 前端 / Frontend | 101 |
| 面板后端 / Panel | 59 |
| 守护进程 / Daemon | 65 |
| 公共模块 / Common | 7 |
| 工作流 / Workflow | 2 |
| 其他 / Other | 18 |

---

## 下载与安装 / Download and Installation

- 文件 / File: `MCSManager-Special-Edition-v4.8.1.tar.gz`
- 安装 / Installation: 解压到目标目录后运行对应平台的启动脚本。
- Installation: Extract the archive and run the startup script for your platform.

# MCSManager Special Edition v4.8.0

## 中文

### 更新概要

v4.8.0 包含 1 个问题修复提交，修复了覆盖文件对话框无法选择重命名和覆盖操作的问题。

### 问题修复

- **修复覆盖文件对话框的选项选择** [4e16e8a](https://github.com/HRxuan/MCSManager-Personal-Edition/commit/4e16e8ad2d9e58ec0dad066983e1ab2407684609)
  - 恢复重命名与覆盖选项的正常选择，避免文件冲突处理流程无法继续。
  - 涉及文件：`frontend/src/hooks/useFileManager.ts`

### 提交清单

- [4e16e8a](https://github.com/HRxuan/MCSManager-Personal-Edition/commit/4e16e8ad2d9e58ec0dad066983e1ab2407684609) 修复: 覆盖文件对话框无法选择重命名和覆盖选项的问题

---

## English

### Summary

v4.8.0 contains one fix that restores the rename and overwrite choices in the file overwrite dialog.

### Fixes

- **Restore option selection in the file overwrite dialog** [4e16e8a](https://github.com/HRxuan/MCSManager-Personal-Edition/commit/4e16e8ad2d9e58ec0dad066983e1ab2407684609)
  - Restores the rename and overwrite choices so file conflict handling can continue normally.
  - Files: `frontend/src/hooks/useFileManager.ts`

### Commit Index

- [4e16e8a](https://github.com/HRxuan/MCSManager-Personal-Edition/commit/4e16e8ad2d9e58ec0dad066983e1ab2407684609) Fix the file overwrite dialog where rename and overwrite options could not be selected
